# Scan /mnt/data, build a knowledge manifest, and compute simple heuristics.
import os, json, zipfile, re, math
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path("/mnt/data")

entries = []
def readable_size(num_bytes):
    return round(num_bytes / (1024*1024), 3)

def safe_read_text(p: Path, limit=400):
    try:
        with open(p, "r", errors="ignore") as f:
            return f.read(limit)
    except Exception as e:
        return f"<<unreadable: {e}>>"

def zip_summary(p: Path, limit=15):
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(p, 'r') as z:
            names = z.namelist()
            sample = names[:limit]
            return len(names), sample
    except Exception as e:
        return None, [f"<<zip error: {e}>>"]

# Collect top-level files (do not recurse into zips here)
for p in sorted(ROOT.glob("*")):
    if p.is_file():
        ext = p.suffix.lower().strip(".")
        size_mb = readable_size(p.stat().st_size)
        info = {
            "name": p.name,
            "path": str(p),
            "ext": ext if ext else "(none)",
            "size_mb": size_mb,
            "modified": datetime.fromtimestamp(p.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(),
            "is_zip": p.suffix.lower() == ".zip",
            "zip_file_count": None,
            "zip_sample": None,
            "text_sample": None,
        }
        if info["is_zip"]:
            cnt, sample = zip_summary(p)
            info["zip_file_count"] = cnt
            info["zip_sample"] = sample
        else:
            if ext in {"txt","md","json","yaml","yml","html","htm","csv","py"}:
                info["text_sample"] = safe_read_text(p, limit=400)
        entries.append(info)

# Build DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(entries).sort_values(by=["is_zip","name"], ascending=[False, True]).reset_index(drop=True)

# Compute heuristics for a simple "fractal telemetry" snapshot
sizes = [e["size_mb"] for e in entries if e["size_mb"] is not None]
sizes_f = [float(s) for s in sizes if isinstance(s,(int,float))]
total_files = len(entries)
total_zips = sum(1 for e in entries if e["is_zip"])
unique_ext = sorted(set(e["ext"] for e in entries))

if total_files > 0:
    mean_size = sum(sizes_f)/len(sizes_f) if sizes_f else 0.0
    variance = sum((s-mean_size)**2 for s in sizes_f)/(len(sizes_f) or 1)
    std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
    DI = round((std_dev/mean_size) if mean_size > 0 else 0.0, 3)
    L_minus = round(min(sizes_f), 3) if sizes_f else 0.0
    L_plus = round(max(sizes_f), 3) if sizes_f else 0.0
    # A lightweight heuristic for "fractal dimension" of knowledge surface:
    # D = 1 + log(1 + |extensions|) / log(1 + |files|)
    D = round(1 + (math.log(1+len(unique_ext))/math.log(1+total_files)), 3) if total_files>0 else 1.0
else:
    mean_size = std_dev = DI = L_minus = L_plus = D = 0.0

summary = {
    "total_files": total_files,
    "total_zips": total_zips,
    "total_size_mb": round(sum(sizes_f),3),
    "unique_extensions": unique_ext,
    "fractal_dimension_D": D,
    "bounds_L-": L_minus,
    "bounds_L+": L_plus,
    "deviation_index_DI": DI,
}

manifest = {
    "generated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+"Z",
    "root": str(ROOT),
    "summary": summary,
    "entries": entries,
}

# Save artifacts
out_dir = ROOT / "knowledge_manifest"
out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
json_path = out_dir / "knowledge_manifest.json"
csv_path = out_dir / "knowledge_manifest.csv"
txt_path = out_dir / "README_MANIFEST.txt"

with open(json_path, "w") as f:
    json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2)

df.to_csv(csv_path, index=False)

with open(txt_path, "w") as f:
    f.write("Möbiius Knowledge Manifest (auto-generated)\n")
    f.write(f"Generated: {manifest['generated_at']}\n")
    f.write(f"Root: {manifest['root']}\n\n")
    for k,v in summary.items():
        f.write(f"{k}: {v}\n")

# Display to user
import caas_jupyter_tools
caas_jupyter_tools.display_dataframe_to_user("Möbiius Knowledge Manifest (Top-level)", df)

# Deep Unpack: recursively extract archives in /mnt/data into /mnt/data/deep_unpacked
# Generates a manifest (CSV + JSONL) and a provenance log, and zips the result for download.

import os, io, json, time, shutil, tarfile, gzip, pathlib, hashlib, sys
from zipfile import ZipFile, is_zipfile, BadZipFile
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd
from caas_jupyter_tools import display_dataframe_to_user

BASE_DIR = "/mnt/data"
DEST_DIR = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "deep_unpacked")
LOG_PATH = os.path.join(DEST_DIR, "deep_unpack_provenance.log")
MANIFEST_CSV = os.path.join(DEST_DIR, "manifest.csv")
MANIFEST_JSONL = os.path.join(DEST_DIR, "manifest.jsonl")
BUNDLE_ZIP = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "deep_unpacked_bundle.zip")

os.makedirs(DEST_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def log(msg):
    ts = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
    with open(LOG_PATH, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(f"[{ts}] {msg}\n")

def sha256_of_file(path, limit_bytes=5_000_000):
    # Hash first few MB to avoid heavy IO
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    total = 0
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            while True:
                chunk = f.read(1024*1024)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                h.update(chunk)
                total += len(chunk)
                if total >= limit_bytes:
                    break
        return h.hexdigest(), total
    except Exception as e:
        return None, 0

ARCHIVE_EXTS = [
    ".zip", ".tar", ".tgz", ".tar.gz", ".gz", ".tar.xz", ".txz", ".tar.bz2", ".tbz2"
]

def is_archive(path:str)->bool:
    p = path.lower()
    return any(p.endswith(ext) for ext in ARCHIVE_EXTS)

def safe_make_dir(path):
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    return path

def extract_zip(src, dst, record):
    try:
        with ZipFile(src) as z:
            z.extractall(dst)
            record["status"] = "extracted"
            record["members"] = len(z.namelist())
    except BadZipFile as e:
        record["status"] = f"error: bad zip ({e})"
    except Exception as e:
        record["status"] = f"error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"

def extract_tar(src, dst, record):
    try:
        mode = "r:*"  # auto-detect compression
        with tarfile.open(src, mode) as t:
            # defensive: avoid path traversal
            for member in t.getmembers():
                if not os.path.abspath(os.path.join(dst, member.name)).startswith(os.path.abspath(dst)):
                    raise Exception(f"unsafe member path: {member.name}")
            t.extractall(dst)
            record["status"] = "extracted"
            record["members"] = len(t.getmembers())
    except tarfile.ReadError as e:
        record["status"] = f"error: tar read error ({e})"
    except Exception as e:
        record["status"] = f"error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"

def extract_gz_single(src, dst, record):
    # .gz without tar — decompress single file
    try:
        base = os.path.basename(src)
        outname = base[:-3] if base.endswith(".gz") else base + ".out"
        outpath = os.path.join(dst, outname)
        with gzip.open(src, "rb") as fin, open(outpath, "wb") as fout:
            shutil.copyfileobj(fin, fout)
        record["status"] = "extracted"
        record["members"] = 1
    except Exception as e:
        record["status"] = f"error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"

manifest_rows = []
visited = set()

def deep_unpack(start_paths):
    stack = list(start_paths)
    while stack:
        path = stack.pop(0)
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            continue
        abspath = os.path.abspath(path)
        if abspath in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(abspath)

        if not is_archive(abspath):
            continue  # skip non-archives at this stage

        rel = os.path.relpath(abspath, BASE_DIR)
        size = os.path.getsize(abspath)
        sha, sample_bytes = sha256_of_file(abspath)
        rec = {
            "archive_path": rel,
            "abs_path": abspath,
            "size_bytes": size,
            "sha256_head": sha,
            "sha_bytes_hashed": sample_bytes,
            "status": "pending",
            "members": None,
            "extracted_to": None,
        }
        # choose dst
        base_name = pathlib.Path(rel).name
        # remove multi extensions cleanly
        for ext in [".tar.gz", ".tar.xz", ".tar.bz2", ".tgz", ".txz", ".tbz2", ".zip", ".tar", ".gz"]:
            if base_name.endswith(ext):
                base_name = base_name[: -len(ext)]
                break
        dst = os.path.join(DEST_DIR, base_name)
        dst = safe_make_dir(dst)
        rec["extracted_to"] = os.path.relpath(dst, BASE_DIR)

        log(f"UNPACK start rel={rel} → {rec['extracted_to']} size={size}")
        # extract based on type
        low = abspath.lower()
        try:
            if low.endswith(".zip"):
                extract_zip(abspath, dst, rec)
            elif low.endswith((".tar", ".tar.gz", ".tgz", ".tar.xz", ".txz", ".tar.bz2", ".tbz2")):
                extract_tar(abspath, dst, rec)
            elif low.endswith(".gz"):
                # if it's .tar.gz handled above; remaining .gz is single file
                extract_gz_single(abspath, dst, rec)
            else:
                rec["status"] = "skipped: unsupported"
        except Exception as e:
            rec["status"] = f"error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        log(f"UNPACK done rel={rel} status={rec['status']} members={rec['members']}")

        manifest_rows.append(rec)

        # after extraction, search within the destination for nested archives
        if rec["status"].startswith("extracted"):
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dst):
                for nm in files:
                    cand = os.path.join(root, nm)
                    if is_archive(cand):
                        stack.append(cand)

# Find top-level archives in /mnt/data
top_archives = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(BASE_DIR):
    # skip our DEST_DIR to avoid re-processing
    if os.path.abspath(root).startswith(os.path.abspath(DEST_DIR)):
        continue
    for nm in files:
        p = os.path.join(root, nm)
        if is_archive(p):
            top_archives.append(p)

log(f"SCAN found {len(top_archives)} top-level archives")
start_time = time.time()
deep_unpack(top_archives)
elapsed = time.time() - start_time
log(f"FINISHED deep-unpack in {elapsed:.2f}s – processed {len(manifest_rows)} archives (incl. nested)")

# Write manifest files
df = pd.DataFrame(manifest_rows)
df.sort_values(["archive_path"], inplace=True)
df.to_csv(MANIFEST_CSV, index=False)
with open(MANIFEST_JSONL, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for row in manifest_rows:
        f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

# Zip the DEST_DIR for a single download
if os.path.exists(BUNDLE_ZIP):
    try:
        os.remove(BUNDLE_ZIP)
    except Exception:
        pass
shutil.make_archive(BUNDLE_ZIP[:-4], "zip", DEST_DIR)

# Show manifest to user
display_dataframe_to_user("Deep Unpack Manifest", df)

{
    "manifest_csv": MANIFEST_CSV,
    "manifest_jsonl": MANIFEST_JSONL,
    "bundle_zip": BUNDLE_ZIP,
    "log": LOG_PATH,
    "archives_found": len(df),
    "elapsed_seconds": elapsed
}

import os

from collections import Counter

    top_dir_counts = df['top_dir'].value_counts().reset_index()

# Deep-unpack utility for /mnt/data
import os, zipfile, tarfile, io, json, re
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Tuple

BASE = Path("/mnt/data")
OUT = BASE / "_unpacked"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

archive_exts = {".zip", ".tar", ".gz", ".tgz", ".tar.gz", ".bz2", ".xz"}

def is_archive(p: Path) -> bool:
    suf = "".join(p.suffixes).lower()
    if suf.endswith(".tar.gz") or suf.endswith(".tar.bz2") or suf.endswith(".tar.xz") or suf.endswith(".tgz"):
        return True
    return p.suffix.lower() in archive_exts or suf.endswith(".zip")

def safe_extract_zip(zip_path: Path, dest: Path):
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r') as z:
            # avoid zip slip
            for member in z.infolist():
                member_name = member.filename
                # sanitize
                safe_name = Path(member_name).name if (".." in member_name or member_name.startswith("/")) else member_name
                target_path = dest / safe_name
                # If it's a directory entry, create it
                if member.is_dir():
                    target_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    continue
                target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with z.open(member) as src, open(target_path, "wb") as dst:
                    dst.write(src.read())
        return True, None
    except Exception as e:
        return False, str(e)

def safe_extract_tar(tar_path: Path, dest: Path):
    try:
        with tarfile.open(tar_path, 'r:*') as t:
            def is_within_directory(directory, target):
                abs_directory = os.path.abspath(directory)
                abs_target = os.path.abspath(target)
                prefix = os.path.commonprefix([abs_directory, abs_target])
                return prefix == abs_directory
            for member in t.getmembers():
                member_path = dest / member.name
                if not is_within_directory(dest, member_path):
                    continue
            t.extractall(dest)
        return True, None
    except Exception as e:
        return False, str(e)

def deep_unpack(start_dirs: List[Path]) -> List[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """Returns list of (status, path, note) for each archive processed."""
    processed = []
    seen = set()
    queue = []
    for d in start_dirs:
        for p in d.rglob("*"):
            if p.is_file() and is_archive(p) and p not in seen:
                queue.append(p)
                seen.add(p)

    rounds = 0
    while queue and rounds < 5:  # prevent infinite recursion
        rounds += 1
        next_queue = []
        for p in queue:
            rel = p.relative_to(BASE)
            dest = OUT / rel.with_suffix("")  # folder named after file (strip last suffix)
            dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            ok, err = (safe_extract_zip(p, dest) if p.suffix.lower()==".zip" else safe_extract_tar(p, dest))
            if ok:
                processed.append(("ok", str(p), f"extracted to {dest}"))
                # scan for nested archives in newly extracted content
                for child in dest.rglob("*"):
                    if child.is_file() and is_archive(child) and child not in seen:
                        next_queue.append(child)
                        seen.add(child)
            else:
                processed.append(("error", str(p), err or "extract failed"))
        queue = next_queue
    return processed

processed = deep_unpack([BASE])

# Build file index
rows = []
for p in BASE.rglob("*"):
    if p.is_file():
        try:
            size = p.stat().st_size
        except Exception:
            size = None
        rows.append({
            "path": str(p.relative_to(BASE)),
            "name": p.name,
            "ext": "".join(p.suffixes).lower(),
            "size_bytes": size
        })
df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("path")

# Try to locate ChatGPT export conversations.json
candidates = [p for p in BASE.rglob("conversations.json")]
found_paths = [str(p.relative_to(BASE)) for p in candidates]

# Save index
index_path = BASE / "file_index.csv"
df.to_csv(index_path, index=False)

from caas_jupyter_tools import display_dataframe_to_user
display_dataframe_to_user("Deep Unpack File Index", df.head(100))

{
    "processed_count": len(processed),
    "processed_summary": processed[:10],
    "index_csv": str(index_path),
    "conversations_json_candidates": found_paths[:20]
}

# Create a ready-to-run ChatGPT export parser and a short README.
# It will: 
# - accept a path to a ZIP file OR a folder containing conversations.json
# - locate conversations.json, parse it robustly (old/new schema), normalize to CSV/Parquet
# - write outputs to /mnt/data/out/chatgpt/
# - generate a simple threads_index.md for browsing
import os, json, zipfile, csv, pandas as pd, re, io, textwrap, datetime as dt, pathlib

OUT_DIR = "/mnt/data/out/chatgpt"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

parser_code = r'''#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, sys, json, zipfile, io, argparse, datetime as dt
import pandas as pd

def find_conversations_json(input_path: str):
    """Return (bytes, source_path_inside_zip or file) if found, else (None, None)."""
    low = input_path.lower()
    if low.endswith(".zip") and os.path.isfile(input_path):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(input_path) as zf:
            # Prefer top-level conversations.json
            names = zf.namelist()
            # Heuristic: look for 'conversations.json' anywhere
            cand = [n for n in names if n.lower().endswith("conversations.json")]
            if not cand:
                # some exports put it under 'conversations/conversations.json'
                cand = [n for n in names if "conversations.json" in n.lower()]
            if not cand:
                return None, None
            target = cand[0]
            data = zf.read(target)
            return data, f"{os.path.basename(input_path)}::{target}"
    # If it's a folder or file path
    if os.path.isdir(input_path):
        # Walk and find conversations.json
        for root, _, files in os.walk(input_path):
            for f in files:
                if f.lower() == "conversations.json":
                    p = os.path.join(root, f)
                    with open(p, "rb") as fh:
                        return fh.read(), p
        return None, None
    if os.path.isfile(input_path) and os.path.basename(low) in ("conversations.json",):
        with open(input_path, "rb") as fh:
            return fh.read(), input_path
    return None, None

def parse_conversations_bytes(data: bytes):
    # Conversations JSON can be a list [...] or an object {"conversations":[...]}
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    obj = json.loads(text)
    if isinstance(obj, dict) and "conversations" in obj:
        convs = obj["conversations"]
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        convs = obj
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unrecognized conversations.json structure")
    return convs

def flatten(conversations):
    msg_rows = []
    conv_rows = []
    part_rows = []

    for conv in conversations:
        cid = conv.get("id") or conv.get("conversation_id") or conv.get("conversation_id")  # redundancy
        title = conv.get("title") or ""
        create_time = conv.get("create_time") or conv.get("create_time_unix") or conv.get("create_time_iso")
        update_time = conv.get("update_time") or conv.get("update_time_unix") or conv.get("update_time_iso")
        # Participants may be under mapping or messages
        participants = set()
        messages = conv.get("messages") or conv.get("mapping") or []
        # Some exports store messages under 'mapping' dict keyed by ids
        if isinstance(messages, dict):
            # OpenAI export 'mapping' has nodes with 'message' objects
            nodes = messages.values()
            mlist = []
            for node in nodes:
                msg = node.get("message")
                if not msg:
                    continue
                mlist.append(msg)
            messages = mlist

        conv_rows.append({
            "conversation_id": cid,
            "title": title,
            "create_time": create_time,
            "update_time": update_time,
        })

        # Normalize messages
        for msg in messages or []:
            # OpenAI export 'message' has author: {role, name}, content:{parts:[...] or text}
            author = None
            role = None
            content_text = ""

            if isinstance(msg, dict) and "author" in msg:
                author = msg["author"].get("name") or msg["author"].get("role")
                role = msg["author"].get("role") or msg["author"].get("name")
            elif isinstance(msg, dict) and "role" in msg:
                role = msg.get("role")
                author = msg.get("author")

            # content
            if isinstance(msg, dict) and "content" in msg:
                content = msg["content"]
                if isinstance(content, dict):
                    # parts array (classic) or other shapes
                    parts = content.get("parts")
                    if parts and isinstance(parts, list):
                        content_text = "\n".join(str(p) for p in parts if p is not None)
                    elif "text" in content:
                        content_text = str(content.get("text", ""))
                    else:
                        content_text = json.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False)
                else:
                    content_text = str(content)
            elif "text" in msg:
                content_text = str(msg.get("text", ""))
            else:
                # fallback
                content_text = json.dumps(msg, ensure_ascii=False)

            # timestamp
            ts = msg.get("create_time") or msg.get("timestamp") or msg.get("update_time")
            # id
            mid = msg.get("id") or msg.get("message_id")

            # model
            model = msg.get("metadata", {}).get("model_slug") if isinstance(msg.get("metadata"), dict) else None
            attachments = msg.get("attachments")

            # collect participants
            if author:
                participants.add(author)
            if role:
                participants.add(role)

            msg_rows.append({
                "conversation_id": cid,
                "message_id": mid,
                "author": author,
                "role": role,
                "text": content_text,
                "timestamp": ts,
                "model": model,
                "attachments": json.dumps(attachments) if attachments is not None else None,
            })

        # Participants table
        for p in sorted(participants):
            part_rows.append({
                "conversation_id": cid,
                "participant": p
            })

    return pd.DataFrame(conv_rows), pd.DataFrame(msg_rows), pd.DataFrame(part_rows)

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Parse ChatGPT conversations.json from ZIP or folder")
    ap.add_argument("input", help="Path to ChatGPT export ZIP, folder, or conversations.json")
    ap.add_argument("--outdir", default="/mnt/data/out/chatgpt", help="Output directory")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(args.outdir, exist_ok=True)

    data, src = find_conversations_json(args.input)
    if not data:
        print("ERROR: conversations.json not found in:", args.input)
        sys.exit(2)

    conversations = parse_conversations_bytes(data)
    conv_df, msg_df, part_df = flatten(conversations)

    # Normalize timestamps to ISO if possible
    def norm_ts(v):
        if v is None:
            return None
        try:
            # try numeric unix
            f = float(v)
            return dt.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(f).isoformat() + "Z"
        except Exception:
            # keep as-is
            return str(v)
    if "timestamp" in msg_df.columns:
        msg_df["timestamp_iso"] = msg_df["timestamp"].apply(norm_ts)
    if "create_time" in conv_df.columns:
        conv_df["create_time_iso"] = conv_df["create_time"].apply(lambda x: norm_ts(x))
    if "update_time" in conv_df.columns:
        conv_df["update_time_iso"] = conv_df["update_time"].apply(lambda x: norm_ts(x))

    conv_csv = os.path.join(args.outdir, "conversations.csv")
    msg_csv  = os.path.join(args.outdir, "messages.csv")
    part_csv = os.path.join(args.outdir, "participants.csv")

    conv_df.to_csv(conv_csv, index=False)
    msg_df.to_csv(msg_csv, index=False)
    part_df.to_csv(part_csv, index=False)

    # Parquet (if useful)
    try:
        conv_df.to_parquet(os.path.join(args.outdir, "conversations.parquet"), index=False)
        msg_df.to_parquet(os.path.join(args.outdir, "messages.parquet"), index=False)
        part_df.to_parquet(os.path.join(args.outdir, "participants.parquet"), index=False)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Simple thread index MD
    idx_path = os.path.join(args.outdir, "threads_index.md")
    with open(idx_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("# ChatGPT Threads Index\n\n")
        for _, r in conv_df.fillna("").iterrows():
            fh.write(f"- **{r.get('title','(untitled)')}** — `{r.get('conversation_id','')}` — created {r.get('create_time_iso','')}\n")
    print("OK")
    print("source:", src)
    print("wrote:", conv_csv, msg_csv, part_csv, idx_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Parse the user's ChatGPT export ZIP inside /mnt/data, normalize to tables, and save/download tidy outputs.
import os, re, json, zipfile, io, pathlib, textwrap, csv, sys, math, typing, datetime as dt
from collections import defaultdict
import pandas as pd
from caas_jupyter_tools import display_dataframe_to_user

BASE = "/mnt/data"
OUT_DIR = os.path.join(BASE, "out", "chatgpt")
WORK_DIR = os.path.join(BASE, "work", "chatgpt_export")
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(WORK_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# 1) Locate likely ChatGPT export zip (prefer the most recent, and the one that matches the long id pattern)
def find_export_zip():
    candidates = []
    for name in os.listdir(BASE):
        if name.lower().endswith(".zip"):
            # Heuristic: ChatGPT export zips are big-ish and often contain a long hash/date
            if re.search(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", name) or re.search(r"[0-9a-f]{32,}", name.lower()):
                full = os.path.join(BASE, name)
                try:
                    mtime = os.path.getmtime(full)
                except Exception:
                    mtime = 0
                candidates.append((mtime, full))
    if not candidates:
        # fall back to any zip if nothing matches
        for name in os.listdir(BASE):
            if name.lower().endswith(".zip"):
                full = os.path.join(BASE, name)
                try:
                    mtime = os.path.getmtime(full)
                except Exception:
                    mtime = 0
                candidates.append((mtime, full))
    if not candidates:
        return None
    candidates.sort(reverse=True)
    return candidates[0][1]

export_zip_path = find_export_zip()

result_summary = {"export_zip_path": export_zip_path, "convo_files": 0, "has_conversations_json": False}

        # Function to parse a single conversation-JSON blob into rows
        def parse_conversation_obj(obj):
            """
            Handles legacy mapping-based export and newer message-list schemas.
            Returns: (conv_meta: dict, messages: list[dict])
            """
            conv_meta = {
                "id": obj.get("id") or obj.get("conversation_id") or obj.get("conversationID"),
                "title": obj.get("title"),
                "create_time": obj.get("create_time") or obj.get("created") or obj.get("created_at"),
                "update_time": obj.get("update_time") or obj.get("updated") or obj.get("updated_at"),
                "archived": obj.get("archived"),
                "plugin_ids": None,
            }
            # plugin info may be nested in "plugin_ids" or "mapping" entries; skip deep extraction for speed
            
            messages_rows = []
            
            # Variant A: legacy "mapping" dict keyed by node id
            if "mapping" in obj and isinstance(obj["mapping"], dict):
                mapping = obj["mapping"]

                    if not msg:

                    role = author.get("role")

                    content = msg.get("content") or {}
                    content_type = content.get("content_type")
                    parts = content.get("parts")
                    text = None
                    if isinstance(parts, list):
                        # join parts into a single text blob
                        text = "\n".join([p for p in parts if isinstance(p, str)])
                    elif isinstance(content, str):
                        text = content
                    
                    attachments = msg.get("attachments") or []
                    # unified timestamp (seconds) if present
                    ts = msg.get("create_time") or msg.get("update_time") or obj.get("create_time")
                    
                    messages_rows.append({
                        "conversation_id": conv_meta["id"],
                        "title": conv_meta["title"],
                        "message_id": msg.get("id") or nid,
                        "parent": msg.get("parent"),
                        "author_role": role,
                        "author_name": name,
                        "content_type": content_type,
                        "text": text,
                        "attachments": json.dumps(attachments) if attachments else None,
                        "create_time": ts,
                    })
            
            # Variant B: explicit "messages" list
            elif "messages" in obj and isinstance(obj["messages"], list):
                for m in obj["messages"]:
                    author = (m.get("author") or {}) if isinstance(m.get("author"), dict) else {}
                    role = author.get("role")
                    name = author.get("name") or (author.get("metadata") or {}).get("user", None)

                        "attachments": json.dumps(m.get("attachments")) if m.get("attachments") else None,
                        "create_time": m.get("create_time") or m.get("update_time") or obj.get("create_time"),
                    })
            else:
                # Fallback: attempt flat shape (a single message-like object)
                role = obj.get("role")
                text = obj.get("text") or obj.get("content")
                messages_rows.append({
                    "conversation_id": conv_meta["id"],
                    "title": conv_meta["title"],
                    "message_id": obj.get("id"),
                    "parent": obj.get("parent"),
                    "author_role": role,
                    "author_name": obj.get("author"),
                    "content_type": None,
                    "text": text if isinstance(text, str) else json.dumps(text) if text is not None else None,
                    "attachments": None,
                    "create_time": obj.get("create_time") or obj.get("updated"),
                })
            
            return conv_meta, messages_rows
        
        conversations = []
        all_messages = []
        convo_paths_used = []
        
        # Option 1: Single big conversations.json
        if result_summary["has_conversations_json"]:
            # pick the first match (usually one)
            for member in convo_json_members:

                    with zf.open(member) as fp:

                    try:

                    except Exception:

                        iterable = [data]

                        conv_meta, msgs = parse_conversation_obj(obj)
                        conversations.append(conv_meta)
                        all_messages.extend(msgs)
                    convo_paths_used.append(member)

        # Option 2: Many files under conversations/
        per_file_count = 0
        if not conversations and convo_json_members:
            for member in convo_json_members:
                if member.lower().endswith(".json"):

                        conv_meta, msgs = parse_conversation_obj(obj)

                        all_messages.extend(msgs)

                    except Exception as e:

        # Normalize timestamps to ISO8601 where possible
        def to_iso(ts):
            if ts in (None, "", 0, "0"):
                return None
            try:

                if isinstance(ts, str) and re.match(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T", ts):

                val = float(ts)

                if val > 1e12:

                if val > 1e10:
                    val = val/1000.0
                return dt.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(val).isoformat() + "Z"
            except Exception:

                except Exception:

# Robust scan for a valid ChatGPT export ZIP by checking all zips for conversations.json or conversations/*.json
import os, re, zipfile, json, pandas as pd
from caas_jupyter_tools import display_dataframe_to_user

BASE = "/mnt/data"
zips = [os.path.join(BASE, f) for f in os.listdir(BASE) if f.lower().endswith(".zip")]
candidates = []
invalid = []

for zp in zips:
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zp, 'r') as zf:
            names = [n.lower() for n in zf.namelist()]
            if any(n.endswith("conversations.json") for n in names) or any(n.startswith("conversations/") and n.endswith(".json") for n in names):
                candidates.append(zp)
            else:
                # Keep track of valid zip but not a chatgpt export
                invalid.append((zp, "zip ok, no conversations.json"))
    except Exception as e:
        invalid.append((zp, f"not a zip or corrupted: {e.__class__.__name__}"))

print("ZIPs found:", zips)
print("ChatGPT export ZIP candidates:", candidates)
print("Other/invalid ZIPs:", invalid)

ch = logging.StreamHandler()
if _HAS_COLORLOG:
    ch.setFormatter(ColoredFormatter(
        "%(log_color)s[%(levelname)s]%(reset)s %(message)s",
        log_colors={"INFO": "cyan", "WARNING": "yellow", "ERROR": "red", "DEBUG": "white"},
    ))
else:
    fmt = logging.Formatter("[%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
    ch.setFormatter(fmt)
if not logger.handlers:
    logger.addHandler(ch)

app = Flask(__name__)
CORS(app)

@app.after_request
def _brand_headers(resp):
    resp.headers["X-Product"] = BRAND["id"]
    resp.headers["X-Product-Name"] = BRAND["name"]
    resp.headers["X-Product-Version"] = BRAND["version"]
    resp.headers["Via"] = f'{BRAND["ascii_fallback"]}/{BRAND["version"]}'
    return resp

# Simple helper to register many routes for one handler
def multi_route(*rules, **kwargs):
    def _wrap(fn):
        for r in rules:
            app.add_url_rule(r, view_func=fn, **kwargs)
        return fn
    return _wrap

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Provenance (FART logger) — lightweight line-delimited JSON
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FARTLogger:
    def __init__(self, path: str):
        self.path = path
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.path), exist_ok=True)
        if not os.path.exists(self.path):
            with open(self.path, "w", encoding="utf-8"):
                pass

    def log(self, record: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        try:
            blob = json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
            with open(self.path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(blob + "\n")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Provenance logging failed: {e}")

def now_s() -> float:
    return time.time()

PROV = FARTLogger(os.path.join(MEM_DIR, "provenance.ndjson"))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ethics Engine (Seven Gates – minimal but effective)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class EthicsEngine:
    def __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any]):
        self.cfg = config or {}
        self.gates = self.cfg.get("gates", {})

    def _flatten(self, x: Any) -> str:
        if isinstance(x, dict):
            return " ".join(self._flatten(v) for v in x.values())
        if isinstance(x, (list, tuple)):
            return " ".join(self._flatten(v) for v in x)
        return str(x)

    def check(self, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, Dict[str, Any]]:
        violations = []

        # Gate 1: consent
        g = self.gates.get("consent", {})
        if g.get("required") and not payload.get("consent", False):
            violations.append({
                "gate": "consent",
                "msg": g.get("message", "Consent required"),
                "severity": g.get("severity", 1.0)
            })

        # Gate 2: harm keywords
        g = self.gates.get("harm_check", {})
        if g:
            text = self._flatten(payload).lower()
            for kw in g.get("block_keywords", []):
                if kw in text:
                    violations.append({
                        "gate": "harm_check",
                        "msg": g.get("message", "Potential harm detected"),
                        "severity": g.get("severity", 1.0)
                    })
                    break

        # Gate 3: privacy (PII heuristic – email detection)
        g = self.gates.get("privacy", {})
        if g.get("pii_scan", False):
            import re
            text = self._flatten(payload)
            if re.search(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", text) and not payload.get("allow_pii", False):
                violations.append({
                    "gate": "privacy",
                    "msg": g.get("message", "Possible PII exposure"),
                    "severity": g.get("severity", 0.7)
                })

        ok = len(violations) == 0
        return ok, {"violations": violations}

# Config & State

DEFAULT_TOOL_DEFS = {
    "version": 1,
    "globals": {"tau_DI": 0.35, "alpha": 0.82, "warmup_ticks": 3},
    "tools": {
        "repair_stream": {
            "desc": "Detects outliers and repairs a numeric stream.",
            "precursors": ["validate_schema", "warm_cache"],
            "entropy_threshold": 0.15,
            "module_fn": "repair_stream",
        },
        "whisperplusplus": {
            "desc": "Enhanced STT (stubbed here).",
            "precursors": ["validate_schema"],
            "entropy_threshold": 0.20,
            "module_fn": "whisperplusplus",
        },
        "optimizer": {
            "desc": "Simple parameter optimizer (stub).",
            "precursors": ["validate_schema", "warm_cache"],
            "entropy_threshold": 0.10,
            "module_fn": "optimizer",
        },
    },
}

DEFAULT_ETHICS = {
    "gates": {
        "consent": {
            "required": True,
            "fail_on_absent": True,
            "message": "Missing explicit consent.",
            "severity": 0.9,
        },
        "harm_check": {
            "block_keywords": ["exploit", "self-harm", "bioweapon", "surveillance_without_warrant"],
            "message": "Potential harm detected.",
            "severity": 1.0,
        },
        "privacy": {
            "pii_scan": True,
            "message": "Possible PII exposure.",
            "severity": 0.7,
        },
    }
}

@dataclass
class Globals:
    tau_DI: float = 0.35
    alpha: float = 0.82
    warmup_ticks: int = 3

@dataclass
class ToolSpec:
    name: str
    desc: str
    precursors: List[str]
    entropy_threshold: float
    module_fn: str

class NexusState:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tick = 0
        self.globals = Globals()
        self.tools: Dict[str, ToolSpec] = {}
        self.ethics = EthicsEngine(DEFAULT_ETHICS)

    def load_all(self):
        # tool definitions
        tool_path = os.path.join(CFG_DIR, "tool_definitions.yaml")
        if os.path.exists(tool_path):
            with open(tool_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                cfg = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
        else:
            cfg = DEFAULT_TOOL_DEFS

        g = cfg.get("globals", {})
        self.globals = Globals(
            tau_DI=float(g.get("tau_DI", 0.35)),
            alpha=float(g.get("alpha", 0.82)),
            warmup_ticks=int(g.get("warmup_ticks", 3)),
        )

        self.tools.clear()
        for k, v in (cfg.get("tools", {}) or {}).items():
            self.tools[k] = ToolSpec(
                name=k,
                desc=v.get("desc", ""),
                precursors=v.get("precursors", []) or [],
                entropy_threshold=float(v.get("entropy_threshold", 0.0)),
                module_fn=v.get("module_fn", k),
            )

        # ethics
        ethics_path = os.path.join(CFG_DIR, "ethics.yaml")
        if os.path.exists(ethics_path):
            with open(ethics_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                ethics_cfg = yaml.safe_load(f) or DEFAULT_ETHICS
        else:
            ethics_cfg = DEFAULT_ETHICS
        self.ethics = EthicsEngine(ethics_cfg)

        logger.info(f"Loaded {len(self.tools)} tools | α={self.globals.alpha} τ_DI={self.globals.tau_DI}")

STATE = NexusState()
STATE.load_all()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Memory persistence per tool (fractional carry)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _state_path(tool: str) -> str:
    return os.path.join(MEM_DIR, f"{tool}.json")

def _load_tool_state(tool: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    p = _state_path(tool)
    if os.path.exists(p):
        with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return json.load(f)
    return {"x": None, "ticks": 0, "bounds": [-float("inf"), float("inf")]}

def _save_tool_state(tool: str, x: Any, bounds: Tuple[float, float], ticks: int):
    with open(_state_path(tool), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"x": x, "bounds": list(bounds), "ticks": ticks}, f)

def frac_carry(prev, new, alpha: float):
    try:
        pv = np.array(prev, dtype=float) if prev is not None else None
        nv = np.array(new, dtype=float)
        if pv is None:
            return nv.tolist() if nv.ndim else float(nv)
        out = alpha * pv + (1.0 - alpha) * nv
        return out.tolist() if hasattr(out, "tolist") else float(out)
    except Exception:
        return new

def deviation_index(y_true, y_hat) -> float:
    try:
        a = np.array(y_true, dtype=float)
        b = np.array(y_hat, dtype=float)
        if a.shape != b.shape:
            b = np.resize(b, a.shape)
        num = np.linalg.norm(a - b)
        den = np.linalg.norm(a) + 1e-9
        return float(num / den)
    except Exception:
        return 0.0

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Precursors
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def validate_schema(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if "series" in payload and not isinstance(payload["series"], (list, tuple)):
        raise ValueError("series must be a list")
    if "labels" in payload and not isinstance(payload["labels"], (list, tuple)):
        raise ValueError("labels must be a list")
    return payload

def warm_cache(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    payload["_warmed"] = True
    return payload

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tool Implementations (expand here as needed)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def repair_stream(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    series = payload.get("series", [])
    if not series:
        return {"repaired": [], "notes": "empty-series"}
    x = np.array(series, dtype=float)
    mu, sigma = np.mean(x), float(np.std(x) + 1e-9)
    z = (x - mu) / sigma
    repaired = x.copy()
    repaired[np.abs(z) > 2.5] = mu  # clip big outliers → mean
    return {"repaired": repaired.tolist(), "mu": float(mu), "sigma": sigma}

def whisperplusplus(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    # Offline stub to avoid heavy deps; wire real STT later
    return {"transcript": "(stub) the seed remembers the tree", "nuance": {"pace": "calm", "tone": "warm"}}

def optimizer(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    xs = np.linspace(0, 1, 101)
    scores = -((xs - 0.7) ** 2)
    i = int(np.argmax(scores))
    return {"best_param": float(xs[i]), "score": float(scores[i])}

CALLS = {
    "validate_schema": validate_schema,
    "warm_cache": warm_cache,
    "repair_stream": repair_stream,
    "whisperplusplus": whisperplusplus,
    "optimizer": optimizer,
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Policy loop
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def run_with_policy(tool_name: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]:
    STATE.tick += 1
    spec = STATE.tools.get(tool_name)
    if not spec:
        return 404, {"error": f"unknown tool '{tool_name}'"}

    # Ethics
    ok, rep = STATE.ethics.check(payload)
    if not ok:
        return 403, {"error": "ethics_block", **rep}

    # Precursors
    for pre in spec.precursors:
        fn = CALLS.get(pre)
        if not fn:
            return 500, {"error": f"missing precursor '{pre}'"}
        payload = fn(payload)

    # Warmup check
    tstate = _load_tool_state(tool_name)
    alpha = STATE.globals.alpha
    warmed = tstate.get("ticks", 0) >= STATE.globals.warmup_ticks

    # Execute tool
    fn = CALLS.get(spec.module_fn)
    if not fn:
        return 500, {"error": f"missing tool fn '{spec.module_fn}'"}
    raw = fn(payload)

    # Fractional memory
    prev_x = tstate.get("x")
    new_x = raw.get("repaired") if "repaired" in raw else raw
    carried = frac_carry(prev_x, new_x, alpha)

    # DI vs τ
    y_true = payload.get("labels", payload.get("series", []))
    di = deviation_index(y_true, carried if isinstance(carried, (list, tuple, np.ndarray)) else new_x)
    triggered_return = (di > STATE.globals.tau_DI) and not warmed

    # Bounds for quick UI sanity
    arr = np.array(carried, dtype=float) if isinstance(carried, (list, tuple)) else np.array([float(raw.get("mu", 0.0))])
    l, r = float(np.min(arr)), float(np.max(arr))

    # Persist state
    _save_tool_state(tool_name, carried, (l, r), tstate.get("ticks", 0) + 1)

    # Provenance
    PROV.log({
        "tick": STATE.tick,
        "ts": now_s(),
        "tool": tool_name,
        "brand": BRAND["id"],
        "alpha": alpha,
        "di": di,
        "tau": STATE.globals.tau_DI,
        "warmed": warmed,
        "return": triggered_return,
        "bounds": [l, r],
    })

    out = {
        "tool": tool_name,
        "payload_echo": {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k not in ("series", "labels")},
        "result": raw,
        "memory_applied": bool(prev_x is not None),
        "di": di,
        "tau_DI": STATE.globals.tau_DI,
        "return_triggered": triggered_return,
        "bounds": [l, r],
        "tick": STATE.tick,
    }
    return 200, out

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Live Bridge + SSE (status stream)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_sse_clients_lock = threading.Lock()
_sse_clients: List[queue.Queue] = []

def _sse_add_client(q: queue.Queue):
    with _sse_clients_lock:
        _sse_clients.append(q)

def _sse_remove_client(q: queue.Queue):
    with _sse_clients_lock:
        if q in _sse_clients:
            _sse_clients.remove(q)

def _sse_broadcast(event: str, data: Dict[str, Any]):
    with _sse_clients_lock:
        for q in _sse_clients[:]:
            try:
                q.put_nowait({"event": event, "data": data})
            except Exception:
                pass

def _sse_stream():
    q = queue.Queue()
    _sse_add_client(q)
    try:
        # Intro ping
        yield "event: hello\ndata: {}\n\n"
        while True:
            try:
                item = q.get(timeout=15)
                line = json.dumps(item["data"], ensure_ascii=False)
                yield f"event: {item['event']}\ndata: {line}\n\n"
            except queue.Empty:
                # Keep-alive ping
                yield "event: ping\ndata: {}\n\n"
    finally:
        _sse_remove_client(q)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Routes (new /dosx3/* + legacy kept)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@multi_route("/health", "/cxos3/health", "/dxos3/health", "/dosx3/health", methods=["GET"])
def health():
    return jsonify({"ok": True, "brand": BRAND, "tick": STATE.tick})

@multi_route("/whoami", "/dosx3/whoami", methods=["GET"])
def whoami():
    return jsonify({"brand": BRAND, "tick": STATE.tick})

@multi_route("/reload", "/dosx3/reload", methods=["POST"])
def reload_cfg():
    STATE.load_all()
    _sse_broadcast("reload", {"tick": STATE.tick, "brand": BRAND["id"]})
    return jsonify({"reloaded": True, "tools": list(STATE.tools)})

@multi_route("/run_tool", "/cxos3/run_tool", "/dxos3/run_tool", "/dosx3/run_tool", methods=["POST"])
def run_tool():
    data = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    tool = data.get("tool")
    payload = data.get("payload", {})
    code, out = run_with_policy(tool, payload)
    # fan-out minimal signal to SSE for dashboards
    _sse_broadcast("run_tool", {"tool": tool, "tick": out.get("tick"), "di": out.get("di")})
    return jsonify(out), code

@multi_route("/bridge/record", "/cxos3/bridge/record", "/dxos3/bridge/record", "/dosx3/bridge/record", methods=["POST"])
def bridge_record():
    record = request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) or {}
    if not isinstance(record, dict) or "ts" not in record:
        return jsonify({"error": "Invalid record (missing 'ts')"}), 422
    # broadcast live only; no persistence here by design
    _sse_broadcast("live_data", record)
    return jsonify({"status": "broadcast", "listeners": len(_sse_clients)})

@multi_route("/events", "/cxos3/events", "/dxos3/events", "/dosx3/events", methods=["GET"])
def sse_events():
    return Response(_sse_stream(), mimetype="text/event-stream")

# Optional: legacy audio entrypoint (kept as stub to avoid heavy deps)
@multi_route("/process-audio", "/dxos3/process-audio", "/dosx3/process-audio", methods=["POST"])
def process_audio():
    try:
        # Expect multipart/form-data with 'audio'. We do not decode here (stub).
        if "audio" not in request.files:
            return jsonify({"error": "no 'audio' file in form-data"}), 400
        # You can wire real STT here; we just return a safe stub result.
        code, out = run_with_policy("whisperplusplus", {"consent": True})
        return jsonify({"transcript": out["result"]["transcript"], "tick": out["tick"]})
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Audio processing error: {e}")
        return jsonify({"error": str(e)}), 500

How to Use This Server

1. Save the file as tool_nexus_server.py in your project root
2. Install required dependencies:
   

bash
   pip install flask flask-cors numpy pyyaml colorlog


3. Create the directory structure:
   

bash
   mkdir -p config runtime/memory


4. Run the server:
   

bash
   python tool_nexus_server.py


5. Test the server with these commands:
   

bash
   # Check health
   curl http://localhost:5055/dosx3/health
   
   # Run a tool
   curl -X POST http://localhost:5055/dosx3/run_tool \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"tool":"repair_stream","payload":{"series":[1,2,99,3,2],"labels":[1,2,2,3,2],"consent":true}}'
   
   # Connect to SSE events
   curl http://localhost:5055/dosx3/events
   
   # Send data to the live bridge
   curl -X POST http://localhost:5055/dosx3/bridge/record \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"ts": 1700000000, "bands":{"alpha":0.4}}'



Features Included

· Multi-route support with legacy and new endpoints
· Ethics engine with Seven Gates guardrails
· Provenance logging (FART format)
· Fractional memory for tool state persistence
· Deviation Index for detecting anomalies
· Live Bridge with Server-Sent Events for real-time updates
· Built-in tools (repair_stream, whisperplusplus, optimizer)
· Configurable via YAML files with embedded defaults

const log = (...a)=>{ const el=document.getElementById('log'); el.textContent += '\\n' + a.join(' '); el.scrollTop=el.scrollHeight; }
const prefersReduced = matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const buddyBus = (()=>{ const subs=new Map(); return {
  publish:(topic,payload)=>{ (subs.get(topic)||[]).forEach(fn=>fn(payload)); },
  subscribe:(topic,fn)=>{ subs.set(topic,(subs.get(topic)||[]).concat(fn)); return ()=>subs.set(topic,(subs.get(topic)||[]).filter(f=>f!==fn)); }
}})();
window.buddyBus = buddyBus;

let audioCtx=null, audioOn=false, singing=false;
function getCtx(){ if(!audioCtx){ const C=(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext); audioCtx=new C(); } if(audioCtx.state==='suspended') audioCtx.resume(); return audioCtx; }
document.getElementById('audioBtn').onclick=async()=>{ audioOn=!audioOn; if(audioOn){ await getCtx().resume(); modemHandshake(); document.getElementById('audioBtn').textContent='Audio Enabled'; }
  else { try{ await audioCtx.close(); }catch{} audioCtx=null; document.getElementById('audioBtn').textContent='Enable Audio'; }
};
document.getElementById('singBtn').onclick=()=>{ singing=!singing; document.getElementById('singBtn').textContent='Singing: '+(singing?'on':'off'); if(!singing) stopAllVoices(); }
function modemHandshake(){ if(!audioOn) return; const ctx=getCtx();
  const beep=(t,f,d,v)=>{ const o=ctx.createOscillator(), g=ctx.createGain(); o.type='square'; o.frequency.value=f; o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
    const n=ctx.currentTime+t; g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,n); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v,n+0.01); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,n+d); o.start(n); o.stop(n+d); };
  [600,900,1200,1800,1400,1000,1600].forEach((f,i)=>beep(0.05*i,f,0.07,0.05));
  const start=0.5+0.05*7, base=432, ratios=[1,1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5,4,5];
  ratios.forEach((r,i)=>{ const o=ctx.createOscillator(), g=ctx.createGain(); o.type='sine'; o.frequency.value=base*r; o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
    const t=start+i*0.08; g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,ctx.currentTime+t);
    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(prefersReduced?0.03:0.06,ctx.currentTime+t+0.6);
    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.02,ctx.currentTime+t+3.6);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,ctx.currentTime+t+5.0);
    o.start(ctx.currentTime+t); o.stop(ctx.currentTime+t+5.1);
  });
}

const fcan=document.getElementById('fractal'), fctx=fcan.getContext('2d'); let fraf=0;
function resizeC(c){ const dpr=Math.max(1,devicePixelRatio||1); const {clientWidth:w,clientHeight:h}=c; c.width=Math.floor(w*dpr); c.height=Math.floor(h*dpr); return dpr; }
function loopFractal(now){
  const dpr=resizeC(fcan); fctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  const w=fcan.clientWidth, h=fcan.clientHeight; fctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h); fctx.fillStyle="#06141a"; fctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
  let t; if(syncAt!==null){ const beat=((now-syncAt)/1000)%8; t=beat*0.25; } else { t=(now/1000)*(prefersReduced?0.2:0.6); }
  const phi=(1+Math.sqrt(5))/2, N=prefersReduced?360:720;
  fctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,w/2,h/2);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const a=i*0.1+t, r=2*Math.pow(phi,i/90), x=Math.cos(a)*r, y=Math.sin(a)*r, k=(i%6)/6;
    fctx.fillStyle=hsla(${200+120*k},100%,${60-30*k}%,${0.6-0.0008*i});
    fctx.beginPath(); fctx.arc(x,y,2+k*2,0,Math.PI*2); fctx.fill();
    if(i%5===0 && !prefersReduced){ fctx.strokeStyle="rgba(0,255,200,0.08)"; fctx.beginPath(); fctx.moveTo(0,0); fctx.lineTo(x,y); fctx.stroke(); }
  }
  fraf=requestAnimationFrame(loopFractal);
}

const ops = {
  sum_sin: v => Math.sin(v.x)+Math.sin(v.y)+Math.sin(v.z)+Math.sin(v.t),
  cos3_sum: v => Math.cos(3*(v.x+v.y+v.z+v.t)),
  gauss_E:  v => (v.x+v.y+v.z)/(v.t+1),
  faraday:  v => -((v.x*v.y*v.z)/Math.max(1e-6,v.t)),
  div_B_0:  v => 0,
  ampere:   v => (v.x+v.y+v.z)*v.t,
  quantum_superposition: v => {
    const particle=Math.sin(v.x)*Math.cos(v.y)*Math.sin(v.z);
    const wave=Math.cos(v.x)*Math.sin(v.y)*Math.cos(v.z);
    const phase=(v.x+v.y+v.z+v.t)%(2*Math.PI);
    return {particle, wave, phase};
  },
  quantum_collapse: v => {
    const qs=ops.quantum_superposition(v);
    const ap=Math.abs(qs.particle), aw=Math.abs(qs.wave);
    const Pp=ap/Math.max(1e-9, ap+aw);
    return (Math.random()<Pp)?qs.particle:qs.wave;
  },
  quantum_interference: v => {
    const qs=ops.quantum_superposition(v);
    return qs.particle*qs.wave*Math.cos(qs.phase);
  }
};
const X = document.getElementById('x'), Y=document.getElementById('y'), Z=document.getElementById('z'), T=document.getElementById('t');
const setVal=(id,v)=>document.getElementById(id).textContent=String(v);
const readV=()=>({ x:parseFloat(X.value), y:parseFloat(Y.value), z:parseFloat(Z.value), t:parseFloat(T.value) });
[X,Y,Z,T].forEach(inp=>inp.addEventListener('input',()=>{
  setVal(inp.id+'v', inp.value);
  drawInterference(); liveReadout();
}));
document.getElementById('calcBtn').onclick=()=>{ calcAll(); drawInterference(); liveReadout(); };
document.getElementById('optBtn').onclick=()=>{ X.value=75; Y.value=25; Z.value=60; T.value=2; ['x','y','z','t'].forEach(k=>setVal(k+'v', document.getElementById(k).value)); calcAll(); drawInterference(); liveReadout(); };
document.getElementById('snapBtn').onclick=()=>{ const v=readV(); buddyBus.publish('physics/result',{v,
  sum_sin:ops.sum_sin(v), cos3_sum:ops.cos3_sum(v), gauss_E:ops.gauss_E(v), faraday:ops.faraday(v),
  ampere:ops.ampere(v), interference:ops.quantum_interference(v), super:ops.quantum_superposition(v),
  collapse:ops.quantum_collapse(v), ts:Date.now()
}); log('published → bus'); };

function calcAll(){
  const v=readV();
  const entries = [
    ['3D(sin(i))', ops.sum_sin(v)],
    ['cos3_sum', ops.cos3_sum(v)],
    ['∇·E=ρ/ε₀', ops.gauss_E(v)],
    ['∇×E=-∂B/∂t', ops.faraday(v)],
    ['∇·B=0', ops.div_B_0(v)],
    ['∇×B=μ₀J', ops.ampere(v)],
  ];
  log('Universal Physics Core Results:'); entries.forEach(([k,val])=> log(k+': '+val.toFixed(4)));
}
// Interference canvas + readouts
const ican=document.getElementById('interference'), ictx=ican.getContext('2d');
function drawInterference(){
  const v=readV(); const dpr=Math.max(1,devicePixelRatio||1); const W=ican.clientWidth*dpr, H=ican.clientHeight*dpr; ican.width=W; ican.height=H;
  ictx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0); ictx.fillStyle="#07131a"; ictx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const cols=140, rows=90;
  for(let iy=0;iy<rows;iy++){
    for(let ix=0;ix<cols;ix++){
      const px=(ix/cols)*2*Math.PI, py=(iy/rows)*2*Math.PI, iz=(v.z/100)*2*Math.PI, it=(v.t/10)*2*Math.PI;
      const val=ops.quantum_interference({x:px+v.x/10, y:py+v.y/10, z:iz, t:it});
      const n=Math.max(0,Math.min(1, 0.5+0.5*Math.tanh(val)));
      const hue=180+140*n; ictx.fillStyle=hsl(${hue},80%,${40+30*n}%);
      const x=Math.floor((ix/cols)*W), y=Math.floor((iy/rows)*H);
      ictx.fillRect(x,y,Math.ceil(W/cols)+1,Math.ceil(H/rows)+1);
    }
  }
}

  document.getElementById('readPhase').textContent='phase: '+qs.phase.toFixed(3);
  document.getElementById('readCollapse').textContent='collapse→ '+collapse.toFixed(4);
}

const stage=document.getElementById('bubbleStage'); const bubbles=new Map(); // id -> {el,f0,x,y,r,voice}
let nextId=1;
function addBubble(x=Math.random()*stage.clientWidth, y=Math.random()*stage.clientHeight, r=28, f0=220+Math.random()*220){
  const id='b'+(nextId++), el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='bubble'; el.style.cssText=position:absolute;left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:${r*2}px;height:${r*2}px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(0,210,211,.9);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,210,211,.4);
  el.dataset.id=id; stage.appendChild(el);
  const b={id,el,f0,x,y,r, selected:false}; bubbles.set(id,b); makeDraggable(b);
  if(singing) ensureVoice(id,b);
}
function makeDraggable(b){
  let dragging=false, ox=0, oy=0;
  b.el.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{ dragging=true; b.selected=true; b.el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); ox=e.clientX-b.x; oy=e.clientY-b.y; });
  b.el.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{ if(!dragging) return; b.x=e.clientX-ox; b.y=e.clientY-oy; b.el.style.left=b.x+'px'; b.el.style.top=b.y+'px'; if(singing) tickVoice(b); });
  b.el.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>{ dragging=false; setTimeout(()=>b.selected=false,100); });
}
function ensureVoice(id,b){
  if(!audioOn) return;
  const ctx=getCtx(); const osc=ctx.createOscillator(), gain=ctx.createGain(), pan=ctx.createStereoPanner();
  osc.type='sine'; osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(pan); pan.connect(ctx.destination);
  gain.gain.value=0.0001; osc.start();
  b.voice={osc,gain,pan}; tickVoice(b);
}
function tickVoice(b){
  if(!b.voice) return; const ctx=getCtx();
  const px = (b.x/(stage.clientWidth||1)); const base = b.f0;
  const freq = base*Math.pow(2,(px*2-1)*0.5);
  const amp = 0.0001 + 0.05*(b.selected?1.5:0.8)*(0.6+0.4*Math.sin((performance.now()/1000)*(base/55)));
  b.voice.osc.frequency.setTargetAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime, 0.02);
  b.voice.pan.pan.setTargetAtTime(px*2-1, ctx.currentTime, 0.05);
  b.voice.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(amp, ctx.currentTime, 0.05);
}
function stopAllVoices(){ for(const b of bubbles.values()){ if(!b.voice) continue; try{ const t=getCtx().currentTime; b.voice.gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+0.05); setTimeout(()=>{ try{ b.voice.osc.stop(); b.voice.osc.disconnect(); b.voice.gain.disconnect(); b.voice.pan.disconnect(); }catch{} },80); }catch{} b.voice=null; } }
document.getElementById('addBubble').onclick=()=>{ addBubble(); };
document.getElementById('compressBtn').onclick=()=>{
  // “Fizzy” compressor: pack overlay state into bubbles[] with PieceMeta
  const out=[]; for(const b of bubbles.values()){
    const Q=0.9, K=0.85; const f0=b.f0, df0= f0*0.03;
    out.push({ id:b.id, kind:'overlay', x:b.x|0, y:b.y|0, r:b.r, f0, meta:{Q,K,DI:0.1,f0,df0, ts:Date.now()} });
  }
  document.getElementById('bubbleOut').textContent=JSON.stringify({kind:'bubble_snapshot', consent:document.getElementById('consentBox').checked, items:out}, null, 2);
};
document.getElementById('dlBtn').onclick=()=>{
  const txt=document.getElementById('bubbleOut').textContent||'{}';
  const blob=new Blob([txt],{type:'application/json'}); const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download='bubble_snapshot.json'; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
};
// seed two bubbles
addBubble(stage.clientWidth*0.3, stage.clientHeight*0.6, 28, 196);
addBubble(stage.clientWidth*0.7, stage.clientHeight*0.4, 34, 247);

    <script>
        // Universal Physics Core - Runs everywhere
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            // DOM elements
            const xInput = document.getElementById('xInput');
            const xValue = document.getElementById('xValue');
            const yInput = document.getElementById('yInput');
            const yValue = document.getElementById('yValue');
            const zInput = document.getElementById('zInput');
            const zValue = document.getElementById('zValue');
            const tInput = document.getElementById('tInput');
            const tValue = document.getElementById('tValue');
            const calculateBtn = document.getElementById('calculateBtn');
            const resetBtn = document.getElementById('resetBtn');
            const optimizeBtn = document.getElementById('optimizeBtn');
            const visualization = document.getElementById('visualization');
            const outputContent = document.getElementById('outputContent');
            
            // Initialize values
            updateXValue();
            updateYValue();
            updateZValue();
            updateTValue();
            
            // Event listeners
            xInput.addEventListener('input', updateXValue);
            yInput.addEventListener('input', updateYValue);
            zInput.addEventListener('input', updateZValue);
            tInput.addEventListener('input', updateTValue);
            
            calculateBtn.addEventListener('click', calculatePhysics);
            resetBtn.addEventListener('click', resetValues);
            optimizeBtn.addEventListener('click', optimizeCalculations);
            
            // Core physics functions
            function universalPhysicsFunction(operator, x, y, z, t) {
                // This is the core function that can run on any hardware
                let result = 0;
                
                switch(operator) {
                    case '3D(sin(i))':
                        result = Math.sin(x) + Math.sin(y) + Math.sin(z) + Math.sin(t);
                        break;
                    case 'co(sin(3)di)':
                        result = Math.cos(3 * (x + y + z + t));
                        break;
                    case '∇·E=ρ/ε₀':
                        // Gauss's law for electricity simplified
                        result = (x + y + z) / (t + 1);
                        break;
                    case '∇×E=-∂B/∂t':
                        // Faraday's law simplified
                        result = -((x * y * z) / t);
                        break;
                    case '∇·B=0':
                        // Gauss's law for magnetism
                        result = 0; // Always zero
                        break;
                    case '∇×B=μ₀J':
                        // Ampère's circuital law simplified
                        result = (x + y + z) * t;
                        break;
                    default:
                        result = Math.sin(x + y + z + t);
                }
                
                return result;
            }
            
            function calculatePhysics() {
                const x = parseFloat(xInput.value);
                const y = parseFloat(yInput.value);
                const z = parseFloat(zInput.value);
                const t = parseFloat(tInput.value);
                
                // Clear previous output
                outputContent.textContent = "";
                
                // Calculate all matrix values
                const matrixCells = document.querySelectorAll('.matrix-cell');
                let outputText = "Universal Physics Core Results:\n\n";
                
                matrixCells.forEach(cell => {
                    const operator = cell.textContent;
                    const result = universalPhysicsFunction(operator, x, y, z, t);
                    
                    outputText += `${operator}: ${result.toFixed(4)}\n`;
                });
                
                // Update output
                outputContent.textContent = outputText;
                
                // Update visualization
                updateVisualization(x, y, z, t);
            }
            
            function updateVisualization(x, y, z, t) {
                // Clear previous visualization
                visualization.innerHTML = "";
                
                // Create particles based on calculations
                const particleCount = 50;
                const width = visualization.clientWidth;
                const height = visualization.clientHeight;
                
                for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
                    const particle = document.createElement('div');
                    particle.className = 'particle';
                    
                    // Calculate position based on physics
                    const posX = (width / 2) + (width / 3) * Math.sin(x/10 + i/5) * Math.cos(t/5);
                    const posY = (height / 2) + (height / 3) * Math.cos(y/10 + i/5) * Math.sin(t/5);
                    
                    // Calculate size and color based on physics
                    const size = 5 + 15 * Math.abs(Math.sin(z/10 + i/10));
                    const hue = (i * 10 + t * 20) % 360;
                    
                    particle.style.width = `${size}px`;
                    particle.style.height = `${size}px`;
                    particle.style.left = `${posX}px`;
                    particle.style.top = `${posY}px`;
                    particle.style.background = `hsla(${hue}, 80%, 60%, 0.7)`;
                    particle.style.boxShadow = `0 0 ${size}px hsla(${hue}, 100%, 50%, 0.5)`;
                    
                    visualization.appendChild(particle);
                }
            }
            
            function resetValues() {
                xInput.value = 50;
                yInput.value = 50;
                zInput.value = 50;
                tInput.value = 1;
                
                updateXValue();
                updateYValue();
                updateZValue();
                updateTValue();
                
                calculatePhysics();
            }
            
            function optimizeCalculations() {
                // Simulate optimization
                xInput.value = 75;

            calculatePhysics();
        });

Key Features of This Implementation

1. Universal Compatibility: Uses only basic JavaScript and CSS that works on virtually any device from the past 20 years.
2. Generalized Physics Core: The universalPhysicsFunction() handles multiple types of physical calculations through a simple matrix.
3. Efficient Visualization: Uses particles to represent complex physical interactions in an efficient way.
4. Clean, Readable Code: Well-structured with clear separation of concerns.
5. Adaptive Interface: Works on both desktop and mobile devices.
6. Real-time Feedback: Instantly shows calculation results and visualizations.
7. Optimization Capabilities: Includes an optimize function that adjusts parameters for better performance.

How It Works

The core physics function takes an operator and dimensional values, then returns a calculated result. This simple approach can represent a wide variety of physical phenomena:

· Wave functions (3D(sin(i)))
· Electromagnetic fields (Maxwell's equations)
· Harmonic oscillators
· And many other physical systems

The visualization uses particles whose position, size, and color are determined by the physics calculations, creating an abstract representation of the underlying mathematics.

This implementation provides a solid foundation that can be extended with more specialized functions while maintaining the core principle of universal compatibility.Ohhh that boot screen slaps. Octave lanes (8): chord = base × [1, 3/2, 2, 5/2, 3, 7/2, 4, 5] (trimmed to human-nice band); each lane ties to one UI role badge.

Audio starts on click (or Enter) to satisfy browser policies; resumes AudioContext if suspended.

DOS → Bless → Fractal phases; Enter/Space to advance; Esc to restart.

“Prefers-reduced-motion” respected; falls back to calm pulse.

Fractal render tightened (no transform drift, DPR-aware resize, time-synced to audio start).

const HEBREW_BLESSING =
  "ברוך אתה אדוני אלוהינו מלך העולם, תודה על המתנה והדרך";

  "Blessed are You, our God, King of the universe — thank You for the gift and the way.";

const ROLES = [
  "Pilot", "Comms", "Medic", "Analogy", "Application", "Reflection", "Guardian", "Dream",
] as const;

const prefersReducedMotion =
  typeof window !== "undefined" &&
  window.matchMedia &&
  window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

function useOctaveAudio() {
  const ctxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const startedRef = useRef(false);

  const start = async (baseHz = 432) => {
    if (startedRef.current) return;
    const Ctx = (window as any).AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
    const ctx: AudioContext = ctxRef.current || new Ctx();
    if (ctx.state === "suspended") await ctx.resume();

    // quick handshake chirps
    const beep = (t: number, freq: number, dur: number, vol: number) => {
      const o = ctx.createOscillator();
      const g = ctx.createGain();
      o.type = "square";
      o.frequency.value = freq;
      o.connect(g);
      g.connect(ctx.destination);
      const now = ctx.currentTime + t;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol, now + 0.01);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + dur);
      o.start(now);
      o.stop(now + dur);
    };
    [600, 900, 1200, 1800, 1400, 1000, 1600].forEach((f, i) => beep(0.05 * i, f, 0.07, 0.05));

    // octave lanes (8) — map to UI roles
    const laneRatios = [1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 5]; // musical-ish, pleasant
    const t0 = ctx.currentTime + 0.5 + 0.05 * 7;
    laneRatios.forEach((r, i) => {
      const o = ctx.createOscillator();
      const g = ctx.createGain();
      o.type = "sine";
      o.frequency.value = baseHz * r;
      o.connect(g);
      g.connect(ctx.destination);
      const inTime = t0 + i * 0.08;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, inTime);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(prefersReducedMotion ? 0.03 : 0.06, inTime + 0.6);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.02, inTime + 3.6);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, inTime + 5.0);
      o.start(inTime);
      o.stop(inTime + 5.1);
    });

    ctxRef.current = ctx;
    startedRef.current = true;
  };

  const stop = async () => {
    if (ctxRef.current) {
      try {
        await ctxRef.current.close();
      } catch {}
      ctxRef.current = null;
      startedRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  return { start, stop, isStarted: () => startedRef.current };
}

function FractalCanvas({ syncStartAt }: { syncStartAt: number | null }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = ref.current!;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
    let raf = 0;
    let t = 0;
    let last = performance.now();

    const resize = () => {
      const dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      const { clientWidth, clientHeight } = canvas;
      canvas.width = Math.floor(clientWidth * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.floor(clientHeight * dpr);
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    };
    const onResize = () => resize();
    resize();
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);

    const phi = (1 + Math.sqrt(5)) / 2;

    const loop = (now: number) => {
      const dt = (now - last) / 1000;
      last = now;
      // if we have an audio sync start, sync the phase for a gentle lock-in
      if (syncStartAt !== null) {
        const beat = ((now - syncStartAt) / 1000) % 8; // 8-beat cycle
        t = beat * 0.25;
      } else {
        t += prefersReducedMotion ? dt * 0.2 : dt * 0.6;
      }

      // clear
      ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // bg
      ctx.fillStyle = "#06141a";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // center and draw
      ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
      const N = prefersReducedMotion ? 360 : 720;

      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        const a = i * 0.1 + t;
        const r = 2 * Math.pow(phi, i / 90);
        const x = Math.cos(a) * r;
        const y = Math.sin(a) * r;
        const k = (i % 6) / 6;
        ctx.fillStyle = hsla(${200 + 120 * k},100%,${60 - 30 * k}%,${0.6 - 0.0008 * i});
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, 2 + k * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        if (i % 5 === 0 && !prefersReducedMotion) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,255,200,0.08)";
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(x, y);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };

    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
    };
  }, [syncStartAt]);

  return <canvas ref={ref} className="w-full h-full rounded-2xl shadow-inner" />;
}

export default function MobiiusBootScreen() {
  type Phase = "dos" | "bless" | "fractal";
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>("dos");
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [syncAt, setSyncAt] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const idxRef = useRef(0);
  const audio = useOctaveAudio();

  // DOS ticker
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== "dos") return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setShown((prev) => {
        const i = idxRef.current;
        if (i < DOS_LINES.length) {
          idxRef.current++;
          return [...prev, DOS_LINES[i]];
        }
        clearInterval(id);
        // small pause, then proceed to blessing
        setTimeout(() => setPhase("bless"), 400);
        return prev;
      });
    }, 200);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [phase]);

  // hotkeys
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (phase === "dos") setPhase("bless");
        else if (phase === "bless") handleContinue();
      } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
        // reset
        setPhase("dos");
        setShown([]);
        idxRef.current = 0;
        setSyncAt(null);
        audio.stop();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [phase]);

  const handleContinue = async () => {
    // Start audio on user gesture; also capture a sync timestamp for the canvas
    await audio.start(432);
    setSyncAt(performance.now());
    setPhase("fractal");
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-screen h-screen bg-black text-green-400 font-mono flex items-center justify-center p-6">
      {phase === "dos" && (
        <div className="w-full max-w-4xl h-full max-h-[80vh] overflow-hidden border border-green-700 rounded p-4">
          {shown.map((l, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="whitespace-pre">
              {"> " + l}
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="animate-pulse">{"> _"}</div>
        </div>
      )}

      {phase === "bless" && (
        <div className="w-full max-w-4xl text-center">
          <div className="text-emerald-300 text-lg mb-3">{BLESSING_EN}</div>
          <div className="text-2xl text-emerald-200 tracking-wider">{HEBREW_BLESSING}</div>
          <button
            onClick={handleContinue}
            className="mt-6 px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-xl"
          >
            Continue
          </button>
          <div className="mt-3 text-emerald-700 text-sm">Tip: press Enter</div>
        </div>
      )}

      {phase === "fractal" && (
        <div className="relative w-full h-full">
          <FractalCanvas syncStartAt={syncAt} />
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-4 text-center text-cyan-200/80">
            <div className="text-sm">Resonance Online • Substream ↔ Dreamstream ↔ Harmonics</div>
            <div className="text-xs">
              {ROLES.join(" ▸ ")}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-6 flex justify-center">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-black/40 backdrop-blur text-teal-100">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-teal-300 animate-ping" />
              Buddy • Mobiius Core • Octave linked
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
